question: In which location were the inaugural National Games, previously known as the 'All India Olympic Games,' held before the independence of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lahore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lahore** was the location where the inaugural National Games, previously known as the '**All India Olympic Games**,' were held before the independence of India.
 
• The first edition of these games took place in **1924**, marking the beginning of organized national-level sports competitions in India.
 
• The event was organized by the Indian Olympic Association, which was established to promote the Olympic movement and develop sports in India.
 
• The games aimed to provide a platform for Indian athletes to showcase their talents and prepare for international competitions such as the Olympic Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Games have evolved over the years, with various cities across India hosting the event to promote sports and athleticism at the national level.
 
• Post-independence, the games continued to be an important part of India's sports culture, encouraging participation from athletes across the country.
 
• The Indian Olympic Association plays a crucial role in organizing the National Games, ensuring they are conducted in accordance with international standards and regulations.
 
• The event includes a wide range of sports, providing a comprehensive platform for athletes from different disciplines to compete and excel.
